# AMD FidelityFX FSR 1

Unmodified public headers from [GPUOpen-Effects/FidelityFX-FSR](https://github.com/GPUOpen-Effects/FidelityFX-FSR), tag `v1.0.2`, commit `a21ffb8f6c13233ba336352bdff293894c706575`.

Both headers contain their complete MIT license notices. Retain these notices when distributing the renderer. No game data is included.

- `ffx_a.h` SHA256 (LF): `f60e2722fcd13989523b9164d776ab382b3692791767f3bf8bb19967f763f3fb`
- `ffx_fsr1.h` SHA256 (LF): `93c3922362ea7fc99cbcc698ca30c98de4f8c246d1fbb0b09e015ddef38ce3a5`

The renderer executes EASU followed by RCAS as two native GPU compute passes. This is spatial FSR 1, not temporal FSR or frame generation.
